ui.guard.screen_unconfirmed.role: Guard consent dialog alert (and a not-sent card's summary when the host gave no reason) when the answer may or may not have landed and a re-read could not tell
ui.guard.screen_unconfirmed.tone: plain, calm, factual; privacy copy, never alarming
ui.guard.screen_unconfirmed.note: No placeholders. Deliberately asserts nothing about the outcome - it must NOT say nothing was shared or sent (the answer may have landed); only that the choice could not be confirmed and where to look. 'Guard' is the product name and 'Settings' is the app's Settings.
